cases.title: A family with early cancers
cases.teaser: A woman had breast cancer at 29, and her brother had an osteosarcoma. You’ll assess a TP53 missense variant at a hotspot and see how it segregates in the family.

cases.title: Triple-negative breast cancer in an Ashkenazi Jewish woman
cases.teaser: This BRCA1 frameshift is a founder variant in Ashkenazi Jewish people. You’ll work through the PVS1 decision tree and decide what its frequency means.

cases.title: A raised phenylalanine on newborn screening
cases.teaser: A baby has two PAH variants in trans, one of them in an intron. You’ll count PM3 points, use the phenotype for PP4 and look at the evidence about splicing.

cases.title: A baby with tetralogy of Fallot and low calcium
cases.teaser: A microarray shows a 2.3 Mb loss at 22q11.2, which you’ll score with the ACMG/ClinGen points for copy-number variants.

cases.title: Epileptic spasms and developmental regression
cases.teaser: Trio exome sequencing has found a de novo SCN2A missense variant. You’ll score the de novo evidence, then look at the predictors and the protein.

cases.title: Profound deafness in a child whose parents are cousins
cases.teaser: A child is homozygous for GJB2 c.35del, a pathogenic variant that is also common. The case covers frequency thresholds for a recessive disorder and why BA1 has exceptions.

cases.title: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy with two MYH7 variants
cases.teaser: One MYH7 variant is of uncertain significance and the other is a benign synonymous change. The case covers the bands of a VUS and gene-specific frequency thresholds.

cases.title: A boy with a large head and autism
cases.teaser: A boy has a canonical splice-site variant in PTEN. Neither parent carries it, but parentage hasn’t been confirmed.
